title: Car Seat Leash for Dogs and Cats, Adjustable Nylon Vehicle Tether
bullets: Adjustable nylon design, per the maker's product listing.
Available in blue, black, and red.
Cloth and metal construction, per the maker's material listing.
Listed weight of 100 g (about 3.5 oz) per unit.
Attach to a harness, not a collar. This is not a crash restraint.
description:
Riding with a pet in the car is easier when the leash is set up before you pull out of the driveway. The maker describes this adjustable car seat leash as a nylon leash for dogs and cats, with cloth and metal materials. It comes in blue, black, and red, and the listed weight is 100 g.

Attach it to a well-fitted harness, never to a collar, and check the fit before every ride. Keep your pet supervised in the vehicle at all times. Look over the leash for wear before each trip and replace it if it looks worn.

This is not a crash restraint. Read the safety warning before use. Orders ship from a US warehouse, and the shipping window is listed in the FAQ below.

faq.a: No. It is not a crash restraint. Attach it to a well-fitted harness and keep your pet supervised in the vehicle.

faq.q: Can I clip it to my pet's collar?
faq.a: No. Attach it to a well-fitted harness, not a collar.
Estimate: 3–5 days to the US after 1–3 days of processing. Ships from a US warehouse.
